text: Started as a postdoctoral researcher and Birgitta Sintring Fellow at Uppsala University (Plant Ecology and Evolution, Department of Ecology and Genetics), working with Mario Vallejo-Marín. New project: how new polyploid species form, using Mimulus peregrinus.
Started a side-quest postdoc at the Department of Botany, UFRGS (Brazil), with Caroline Turchetto, on the evolutionary history and conservation of Nicotiana sect. Alatae (CAPES AURORA Program).
Completed a research visit to Péter Poczai's group at the Finnish Museum of Natural History, University of Helsinki, funded by the ESEB Godfrey Hewitt Mobility Award.
New preprint on bioRxiv: The Speciation Continuum in Bloom, on incomplete lineage sorting, gene flow and reticulate evolution. See Publications.
New preprint on bioRxiv: does the choice of reference genome change evolutionary inference in young species?
Paper on hybridization between two Nicotiana sect. Alatae species out in Annals of Botany.
Started as a postdoctoral researcher at IBMCP (CSIC-UPV), Valencia, with a CNPq postdoctoral fellowship.
Presented a poster at ESEB 2025 in Barcelona.
